assembly.type: บานเปิดเดี่ยว (วงกบไม้ 4") single swing door
assembly.joints: Frame U1778 on head + 2 jambs only, no sill (door bottom rail clears floor). Leaf: stiles M41078 (hinge) and M30037 (lock) run full height; top and bottom rails U3224A (65) sit between the stiles (elevation shows square butt corners, not mitred) - butt vs mitre not dimensioned, estimated.
assembly.clearances_mm: wall to frame 4 (sealant + backer) all round; frame rebate to leaf top 4; leaf bottom to floor 5; frame depth 101.6 = 36.4 (leaf zone) + 62.5; hinge jamb: 4 | 44.45 frame | 68.5 to glass line; lock jamb: 72.2 | 44.45 | 4
assembly.notes: ไม่มีสูตรตัดพิมพ์ในคู่มือ (คู่มือมีแต่รูปตัดติดตั้ง). Not printed: cut lengths, glass sizes. Gaps below are read from the section drawings only.

assembly.type: บานเปิดคู่ multipoint lock
assembly.joints: Same frame (head+jambs, no sill). Two leaves; meeting stiles both M30037 with 10 mm gap between them; hinge stiles M41078.
assembly.clearances_mm: meeting gap 10; dims each side of gap 76.3; jambs 4 | 44.45 | 68.5; head 4 gap; floor 5
assembly.notes: ไม่มีสูตรตัดพิมพ์ในคู่มือ (คู่มือมีแต่รูปตัดติดตั้ง). Not printed: cut lengths, glass sizes. Gaps below are read from the section drawings only.

assembly.type: บานเปิดเดี่ยว + ช่องแสงข้าง + ช่องแสงบน multipoint
assembly.joints: Transom U6307 runs over the door between the jambs; mullion U6307 between door and side lights (runs full height - estimated from elevation). Fixed lights glazed directly in U1778/U6307 with bead U2256 + glass clip; under the side light U1778 is also used as a sill (section 5), the door opening has no sill.
assembly.clearances_mm: door leaf under transom: 4 gap (section 6: 4 | 21.05); side light sill U1778 sits 4 above floor (sealant); 101.6 depth = 28.5 + 10.3 + 62.8 for U6307
assembly.notes: ไม่มีสูตรตัดพิมพ์ในคู่มือ (คู่มือมีแต่รูปตัดติดตั้ง). Not printed: cut lengths, glass sizes. Gaps below are read from the section drawings only.

assembly.type: บานเปิดคู่ + ช่องแสงข้าง 2 ข้าง + ช่องแสงบน
assembly.joints: Double leaf (M30037 meeting, 10 gap) under transom U6307; side lights each side separated by U6307 mullions; outer frame U1778 incl. sill under side lights.
assembly.clearances_mm: meeting 76.3 | 10 | 76.3; mullion side 44.45 | 67.9 to glass line; jamb 4 | 44.45
assembly.notes: ไม่มีสูตรตัดพิมพ์ในคู่มือ (คู่มือมีแต่รูปตัดติดตั้ง). Not printed: cut lengths, glass sizes. Gaps below are read from the section drawings only.
